<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Share+Tech+Mono&display=swap');
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 212 79% 28%;
  --foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --card: 212 79% 28%;
  --card-foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --popover: 212 79% 24%;
  --popover-foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --muted: 212 70% 34%;
  --muted-foreground: 210 60% 88%;
  --accent: 212 70% 36%;
  --accent-foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --border: 210 60% 80%;
  --input: 210 60% 80%;
  --ring: 0 0% 100%;
  font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, Consolas, Menlo, monospace;
  background-color: {{accentColor}};
  background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size: 100px 100px, 100px 100px, 20px 20px, 20px 20px;
  background-position: -1px -1px;
}
.login-content > div {
  max-width: 440px;
}
.login-topbar button {
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-panel {
  position: relative;
  overflow: visible;
  border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 92%, #000000);
  color: #ffffff;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 92%, #000000), 0 0 0 7px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45);
}
.login-panel::before {
  content: 'FIG. 1  SIGN-IN FORM';
  position: absolute;
  top: -9px;
  left: 18px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 92%, #000000);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  line-height: 16px;
  white-space: pre;
}
.login-panel::after {
  content: 'SCALE 1:1    REV A';
  position: absolute;
  right: 18px;
  bottom: -9px;
  padding: 0 8px;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 92%, #000000);
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
  font-size: 11px;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  line-height: 16px;
  white-space: pre;
}
.login-logo-box img {
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  border-radius: 0;
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  font-family: inherit;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: #ffffff !important;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #ffffff;
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.75);
  border-radius: 0;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
  color: #ffffff;
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 15px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border: 1px solid #ffffff;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
}
.login-password button {
  color: #ffffff;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border: 1px solid #ffffff;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: transparent;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: #ffffff;
  color: {{accentColor}};
}
.login-form a {
  color: #ffffff;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-style: dashed;
  text-underline-offset: 4px;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 46px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 0;
  background: #ffffff;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 400;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-signup-link span,
.login-form .login-forget-password label {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
}
#footer {
  color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
}
#footer img {
  filter: brightness(0) invert(1);
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
